name: Clan Baíscne

attributes.attribute: followers of the hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill
rival band of the one-eyed Goll Mac Morna
band that arose when the two clans united

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Clan Baíscne is the name given to the followers of the great hero Fionn Mac Cumhaill. They used this name most often when they faced the followers of the one-eyed Goll Mac Morna. Those enemies bore the name Clan Morna. In time the two hostile clans joined to form the band called the Fianna.

okr.objective: The Clan Baíscne was the war band of Fionn, and it joined the Clan Morna to form the Fianna.
key_results: The Clan Baíscne named the followers of Fionn Mac Cummaill.
Its old rival was the Clan Morna of Goll.
The two clans merged to create the Fianna.
